summary: PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) filed a Form 6-K announcing an Extraordinary General Meeting of Shareholders (EGMS) to be held electronically on September 30, 2026. The announcement sets the record date of September 7, 2026, and outlines procedures for the e-meeting via KSEI's eASY system, agenda proposal deadlines, and eligibility requirements per Indonesian regulations. This is a routine corporate governance notice, not a special situation event.
